title: R 75
subtitle: 82 keys and a dial on the R GRID board
context: Personal project. A design, not built.
role: Direction and design, with AI tools for the drawings and renders
summary: R 75 is one of four keyboards in the R GRID series, designed in 2026. A row of function keys set a quarter of a key above the rest, and a blue dial at the top right.

sections.heading: The board
sections.body: A row of function keys set a quarter of a key above the rest, and a blue dial at the top right. It is built like the rest of the series: a black board printed with the grid, low keycaps, a frosted white base, and blue for the spacers and feet.

sections.heading: From the side
sections.body: From the desk up: a frosted base and frame with brass nuts set into it, a white circuit board, blue spacers and the black board. The feet are clear blue pieces held by cross bolts.
